[EN] To Penetrate the Shadows
[ES] Para penetrar en las sombras
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the southeast road. Watch for my scouts!
[ES] Toma el camino sureste. ¡Cuidado con mis exploradores!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] With you in camp? Yes, today will be good indeed!
[ES] ¿Contigo en el campamento? ¡Sí, hoy será un buen día!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Drive back blighted amani berserkers and priests, and bleakbone legionaries to clear the road into Dakonan Junction.
[ES] Rechaza a los berserkers y sacerdotes amani marchitos, y a los legionarios de hueso sombrío para despejar el camino hacia Dakonan Junction.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Very happy to help!"
[ES] "¡Muy feliz de ayudar!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Join Baraz at Dakonan Overwatch.
[ES] Únete a Baraz en Dakonan Overwatch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
